newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador Feb inflation up 0.5 pct - ministry.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador Feb inflation up 0.5 pct - ministry.

text.p: February inflation in El Salvador slowed to a 0.5 percent rise from a 1.7 percent advance in January, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.
"The low increase in prices for February is in line with the usual trend at this time of the year and reflects a high degree of stability..." a statement from the ministry said.
El Salvador expects 1997 inflation to end at between 5 and 7 percent against the 7.4 percent recorded in 1996.
